Hero.title: Digital solutions that move your business forward
Hero.description: Seekursor is a digital solutions agency. We help businesses serve their customers better, simplify their operations and grow.

Process.title: Understand first. Build next
Process.description: Every business works differently. We start with your reality to choose a solution that fits.

items.title: Understand
items.description: We discuss your business, your customers and what you want to improve.

items.title: Identify
items.description: We identify the real challenges and choose the priority worth addressing.

items.title: Design
items.description: We shape a clear response, using a prototype when it helps you decide.

items.title: Build
items.description: We develop, test and refine the solution with you before it goes live.

Projects.title: Ideas made tangible
Projects.description: A few examples to imagine what a digital solution could bring to a business.

items.title: A restaurant, easier to reach
items.description: Browse a menu and prepare an order from your phone.
items.longDescription: An example of a customer journey for a restaurant: an organized menu, useful information in one place and an easy way to get in touch. This concept illustrates a direction to explore, not a measured client result.

items.title: A business, clearly presented
items.description: A clear presentation of services to make the first conversation easier.
items.longDescription: A website concept for a service business. It organizes the offering, answers initial questions and makes contact details easy to find, without adding unnecessary pages.

items.title: A catalogue, easier to use
items.description: Explore products and prepare a request without a complicated process.
items.longDescription: A digital catalogue demonstration for a shop. Products are organized to help customers make a choice and prepare a request. The level of complexity then depends on the shop’s actual needs.

Differentiation.purposeTitle: A solution should have a reason to exist
Differentiation.purposeDescription: We focus on what helps you work better or serve your customers better. We define the scope with you, based on your priorities.
Differentiation.reachTitle: Rooted in Haiti. Open to new horizons
Differentiation.reachDescription: Seekursor is growing from Haiti, with attention to the ways local businesses work and what they need. Our ambition is to bring the same approach to other markets.

Founder.title: A direct conversation with the founder
Founder.imageAlt: Illustration of a workspace for digital design
Founder.statement1: Harly Thelusma founded Seekursor around a simple idea: understand the business before deciding what to build.
Founder.statement2: Based in Haiti, he works directly with you to turn a concrete need into a useful digital solution.

FinalCTA.title: Let’s talk about your business
FinalCTA.description: Serve your customers better, simplify your operations or grow your business: let’s start by understanding what matters to you.
FinalCTA.help: Chat on WhatsApp or choose a time for a discovery call.
